mainEntity.name: Can a Conveyor System Be Customized to My Exact Plant Layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. TRF conveyor systems are custom engineered around your production flow, layout and operational requirements, using standard modules for conveying, transfers, accumulation, routing and elevation. Levels, columns, aisles and the positions of the machines at both ends are part of the layout study, so the system fits the plant you have instead of a catalog drawing.

mainEntity.name: Can a Conveyor System Integrate With My Palletizer and Case Packer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. TRFIntraflow includes system integration modules with sensors, PLC and HMI, barcode and vision interfaces, machine communication and palletizer interfaces. Because TRF also supplies case packing and palletizing platforms, the conveyor can be designed with them as one end-of-line system. Interfaces with equipment already installed are defined during project engineering, within the scope agreed for each project.
